events.title: NASA Established
events.description: President Dwight D. Eisenhower signed the National Aeronautics and Space Act, creating the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) as a civilian agency to lead American space exploration, replacing the NACA.
events.significance: NASA went on to lead the Apollo Moon landings, space shuttle program, and robotic exploration of the solar system, shaping the course of the Space Race and modern space science.

events.title: Wedding of Prince Charles and Lady Diana Spencer
events.description: Charles, Prince of Wales, married Lady Diana Spencer at St Paul's Cathedral in London in a ceremony watched by an estimated 750 million people worldwide.
events.significance: The wedding was one of the most widely viewed television events in history, and Diana became a global cultural icon whose life and death profoundly influenced the British monarchy and public perceptions of royalty.

events.title: Death of Vincent van Gogh
events.description: Dutch Post-Impressionist painter Vincent van Gogh died at age 37 in Auvers-sur-Oise, France, two days after shooting himself in the chest.
events.significance: Largely unrecognized during his lifetime, Van Gogh became one of the most influential artists in Western history, and works such as The Starry Night and Sunflowers are among the most celebrated paintings in the world.

events.title: Birth of Alexis de Tocqueville
events.description: French political thinker and historian Alexis de Tocqueville was born in Paris. He later traveled through the United States and wrote Democracy in America.
events.significance: Democracy in America remains a foundational analysis of democratic society, political culture, and equality, and continues to be widely cited in political science and history.

events.title: Assassination of King Umberto I of Italy
events.description: King Umberto I was shot and killed in Monza by the anarchist Gaetano Bresci, who said he was avenging the victims of a violent suppression of bread riots in Milan in 1898.
events.significance: The killing brought Victor Emmanuel III to the throne, and he reigned during the rise of Fascism in Italy, and it highlighted the wave of anarchist violence at the turn of the 20th century.
